limitations: MallocStackLogging records libmalloc and VM allocations; Rust allocations reach it only as jemalloc extent mmaps
family classification is regex-based on symbol names; unclassified and image:* rows are reported rather than guessed
malloc_history itself perturbs the process and the settled state is sampled once per stage
one synthetic data URL, one operating system, one architecture and one Servo release
run pairing across cells is by index, not by shared process

gate.criterion: leading libmalloc family holds at least 0.70 of per-cycle libmalloc growth in every run pair

semantic.per_cycle: (high-cycle bytes - low-cycle bytes) / (high cycles - low cycles), paired by run index
semantic.tool: malloc_history -allBySize on the live process; live allocations grouped by allocation primitive and by the innermost non-allocator frame's family
semantic.warm_up: post_all_closes minus empty in the low-cycle cell
